notes.title: New DLC Announcement, “The Promised Land”
notes.content:
Hello everyone, PiedPipers team here. 

Introducing a brand new DLC, The Promised Land! The DLC includes two separate captivating stories: one set in Europe and one set in the Middle East. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35393732/5fc2f6aab6f61b33a9d07f8fbdde0ba9f77e908c.gif[/img]

The names of the two scenarios are: 
[list]
[*] Assassin's Cruise
[*] Kingdom of Jannah
[/list]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1558310/_/

We’ve also made some improvements & bug fixes. Here’s the patch notes:

[list]
[*] Users will now have access to all of the game’s scenarios without having to unlock them.
[*] Added two new troop types (Plantagenet Royal Guard, Elite Assassin)
[*] ‘Ally Battle’ system added
[*] New scenario ending cutscene added 
[*] ‘Chest’ system improved 
[list]
[*] Blessings change to Hardships based on chance 
[*] Hardships are now automatically removed after a certain time
[/list]
[*] Changes to Duchy of Normandy & Kingdom of England: 
[list]
[*] Kingdom of England : Highlander → Plantagenet Royal Guard
[*] Duchy of Normandy : None → Highlander 
[/list]
[*] The Inn now only restores troop morale
[*] Length of battlefields changed
[*] AI will retreat faster when its siege weapon is destroyed
[*] UI bug fixes
[/list]

Neowiz's Publisher Sale starts on March 11th!
Plebby Quest will be 45% off during that time, so if you haven't bought it already this would be the perfect opportunity to do so.

- PiedPipers team

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35393732/0df77118d0aa666b17bafd7d7c494a866f8e0092.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Update Announcement
notes.content:
Hello! 

PiedPipers Team here.

We’re excited to introduce the new game mode for Plebby Quest called the “Land of Chaos”.  This new mode features 7 unique maps where the religions, empires and regions’ locations always appear randomly, so each time you play it is a completely different experience! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35393732/d9298c5a846b6b88b82a209fba7e8e47f485c494.gif[/img]

Not only that, but the Free Play mode has also been improved through Blessings and Hardships which will add a lot of variety to the gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35393732/76fb9cffc4be6ffa45d5f971cb21e2c48a208abb.gif[/img]

 And last but not least, the following bugs have been fixed and improvements made.

-Monastery & Policing Automatization, Research Location Changed
 - Fixed bug where in certain situations you could continuously get Outlaw Special Forces
 - Added the ability to denounce heresy at the religious conference
 - Added Steam Achievements (New Mode & Blessings/Hardships)
 - Misc. bug fixes

[b]However like we stated in a previous post, this update will not affect your stats regarding ‘game completions’ or anything that you’ve unlocked, but it will NOT work with previous save files. So if you have any games that are currently in-progress, you unfortunately will not be able to finish them.[/b]

This is something we’ve been talking about since launch, so we’re sorry that it took so long to share this content with you. We’ll keep trying our hardest to make the best possible version of Plebby Quest that we can and hope that it creates a lot of good gaming memories for you. 

We also hope that you have a great end to the year. See you again soon!

 - PiedPipers Team

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35393732/a521b990d357478f66643ba19c7bad0158d133f6.png[/img]

notes.title: Update- Advance Announcement
notes.content:
Hello,

PiedPipers Team here!

We’re almost done with the next update and are on-track to release it on [u][b]December 18th[/b][/u]. 

There are a couple important things that we need to share with you beforehand though.

The next patch will mainly consist of the following two items.

[list]
[*] Altering the Chest System
[*] Adding a new mode
[/list]

[b]Please note that this update will NOT work with your currently-saved games and you won’t be able to complete them after installing the patch. This will not adversely affect your number of ‘game completions’ or unlocked features though.[/b]

This update was a major undertaking for our development team and the above situation was unavoidable, so we hope that you can understand and have enough time to finish all of your games that are currently in-progress.

That being said, we really hope that you enjoy the new contents!

- PiedPipers Team-

notes.title: Update Schedule Change
notes.content:
Hello, 

PiedPipers Team here.

First of all, thank you once again for playing our game. We really appreciate it.

Unfortunately, we’ve decided to push back our next update. We had planned on releasing a new patch and DLC this year, but after reviewing your feedback have come to the conclusion that we need more time.

Please accept our sincere apology for this sudden and unexpected delay.

That being said, if all goes according to plan our next update will go live in December and the DLC will follow in February.

Both the new update and DLC will provide tons of new content, the key parts of which are listed below.

[h3][b][Update- December][/b][/h3]
New Mode

[h3][b][DLC- February][/b][/h3]
2 New Scenarios

Please just keep in mind that we’re delaying the release of all this to provide the highest-quality experience that we can. We promise that the wait will be worth it!

notes.title: Patch Notes (1.55 ver.)
notes.content:
Hello Again!

We’re pleased to finally welcome the German and Chinese-speaking communities to Plebby Quest. You can now enjoy it in your native languages!

The main goal of this patch was to provide a lot of ‘quality of life’ improvements that would make for a more satisfying gaming experience. We’re just sorry that we couldn’t deliver these changes even earlier or during the initial launch. Rest assured that we’ll continue to improve the game to the best of our ability going forward though!

However please keep in mind that this update will NOT allow you to finish any games that are currently in progress (your overall save data regarding game completions and unlocked features will not be adversely affected though).

The key features of this update are as follows:


[h3]Additional Language Support[/h3]
- German, Chinese (Simplified & Traditional)

[h3]New Ruins Added[/h3]
- Added new Ruins, Generals & Troops that are inspired by German and Chinese culture
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35393732/36b2096a613dd703679003d25f6be024fbea7cc5.gif[/img]


[h3]Improved Autobot[/h3]
- Made a Monastery Bot : The Bot will take care of praying, cataloging books and producing luxuries.
- Combined pre-existing autobots (wall repair, patrol, etc) to create Public Order Bot
- In case you assign the Public Order Bot to suppress armed rabble, a General that will undoubtedly win will be chosen and the battle will proceed automatically.

[h3]Improved Coin Mini-game[/h3]
- Changed Religious Conference persuasion to work the same as conversations in the Inn.
- No longer done in mid to late game thanks to Monastery Bot

[h3]Optimized Battle Speed[/h3]
- Sped up auto battles

[h3]Miscellaneous[/h3]
- Adjusted time when rivals/allies appear
- Changed frequency of acquiring empire-specific troops to 1 (Including allies & captors)
- Improved UI for Currency Mini-game
-  Fixed it so that Celtic Longbowman will not be detected when sending a volley in Ruins.
- Added Diplomatic & Religious Relation Points
- Minor balancing changes

[h3]Final Warning[/h3]
- Currently in-progress games will not work with this update.

notes.title: Development Roadmap
notes.content:
Hello!
 
This is the PiedPipers Team.
 
First of all, thank you very much for playing Plebby Quest!
 
Have you been waiting to hear from us though?
 
Our team has undergone some recent changes and we’ve been hard at work planning out the future of Plebby Quest, so we weren’t able to communicate with our Community as much as we would’ve liked.
 
With that being said, please see below for our Development Roadmap!
 
Our plan takes into account all of the valuable feedback we’ve received from you all and also includes adding several languages to allow more people to enjoy the game.
 
[h3][August][/h3]
Localization & 1st Patch
 - We’ll be adding 3 languages to the game (German, Simplified and Traditional Chinese) and plan to add even more in the future.
 - We plan on improving the game’s replayability and adjust it’s balancing to change the mid-late game.
 
[h3][December][/h3]
2nd Patch
 - will include extra play mode.
 - The 2nd Patch will improve the battle system and add troops. (DLC purchase not required)

[h3][Feburary 2021][/h3]
 DLC
- The paid DLC will include 2 new scenarios.

Simply put, we hope to make Plebby Quest an “Enjoyable Gaming Experience” for everyone.
 
 PiedPipers Team

notes.title: Plebby Quest: The Crusades Officially Launches on Steam
notes.content:
[h1]Plebby Quest: The Crusades Officially Launches on Steam[/h1]
[h2]‘Will you burn your enemies? Or will you be burnt?’[/h2]

It’s official! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/334310/Plebby_Quest_The_Crusades/][i]Plebby Quest: The Crusades[/i][/url], our turn-based indie strategy game developed by PiedPipers Team and published by [url=https://www.neowizglobal.com/]NEOWIZ[/url], is available now on Steam, 20% off through April 16 for $15.99 USD. Packed full of parody and tongue-in-cheek personality, there’s never been a better age for a crusade!

[previewyoutube=pKrcKnmApEc;full][/previewyoutube]

Crafted in a whimsical, hand-drawn art-style, Plebby Quest is set in Europe and the Middle-East during the age of crusaders. Players must survive between ambitious rulers dreaming of building an empire, treacherous neighbours that long to burn your kingdom, and religious leaders insisting unreasonable demands. Ultimately, the goal is simple, survive long enough to build a legacy to last the ages.

At launch, the game features two game modes, Scenario and Sandbox, three unique campaigns, numerous minigames, and a dynamic decision-making system affecting current and future playthroughs. What’s more, the combat system incorporates 40 troop types and 100 Generals, all packed full of personality and parody, and ready for your command.

“Plebby Quest is the culmination of more than 9 years of development, and an unwavering commitment to recognizing a childhood dream,” said Jumyeong Kim, game director at PiedPipers Team. “Today, I share my dream with the world, and hope they enjoy what we’ve created.”
 
For more information, visit the [url=http://plebbyquest.com/]Official Site[/url] and follow the PiedPipers Team on [url=http://plebbyquest.com/#section04]social media[/url].

Want to request a Review Copy of Plebby Quest? Fill out the form [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSezJ63AB2r0vTM_iD1L-MJ-VW3joip55edielAVdm5ye91P9g/viewform]here[/url]!

notes.title: [NEWS] BIC 2015
notes.content:
[h1]History is always the best topic. ‘Army and Strategy : Crusades[/h1]

[url=]https://youtu.be/71WMelCxkrk[/url]

Personally I love interesting tidbits in history. When studying history, the quote “Truth is stranger than fiction.” makes sense a lot. Also these kinds of irregular happenings in history ends to be from war or crises. This maybe why war history is steady-seller in history books.

 ‘Army and Strategy’ is a case where these critical moments are told by a strategy game. At first you will be hooked by it’s unique art and character designs. As you play the scenarios regarding the historical events it will feel like grandfather telling old stories.

Perhaps one of the strengths of this game is that it combines history with a modern taste. In fact, there have been several attempts that tried to make users laugh by all the parodies in the game. And this game has mastered this perfectly. It's not easy to deal with all these dialogues nor is it easy to express things in SD character. However  ‘Army and Strategy’ has very immersive and interesting stories and it makes us laugh quite a lot.

And most of all, the best thing about  ‘Army and Strategy’  was it’s system that used the political and religious situations of the time. In fact, from the middle ages till modern times, Europe had a lot of conflicts regarding politics and religion. In most of these cases war were superficial. It like watching the political conflict in the Game of Thrones, and you can solve them by using such means. For example, In religious meetings you can denounce your enemies as a heretic then vote on them. And while the vote is being cast, you show your holy relic to emphasize your righteousness, so that your opponents will be branded as a heretic.One by one, you dominate by removing your opponents.
